notes: Four seeds are averaged within each case; case averages have equal weight.
Every mean close, high, and low prediction is scored at every matched target, including invalid candles. Open is checked for finiteness, not scored.
Normalized MAE = close-price MAE divided by the common last observed close.
MAE vs flat is a mean of per-case ratios, not a ratio of pooled dollar errors. Values below one beat the unchanged-price benchmark.
Terminal direction compares forecast and actual tenth-bar moves relative to the last input close, not individual step signs.
The reused-date case is RDW hourly at the Nov5 cutoff. Cases are correlated, not independent market events.
Historical IEX data retrieved now may include revisions. This is retrospective validation, not point-in-time trading proof.
Elapsed and CPU times exclude weight loading and data fetch. No production source or saved graphs changed.
